notes.title: Offroad Mechanic Simulator PlayStation Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello Offroad Mechanics!

We are thrilled to announce that the release date for Offroad Mechanic Simulator on PlayStation has been set for July 3rd! This is a huge step forward for us, and we want to share a few details of what you can expect.

This isn't our usual Steam release but we're eager to connect with our new PlayStation adventurers. Our Discord server will serve as a hub for discussions and feedback.

We can't wait for July 3rd to have you join us in this exciting offroad mechanic adventure on PlayStation. Get ready for challenges, and plenty of satisfaction from working on (and driving in) offroad vehicles!

Sadly, the Xbox version will be released at a later date. Due to issues beyond our control, we're unable to launch both versions simultaneously.

If you want to bring the offroad adventure to consoles, check out the game on the PlayStation Store.

See you on the trails!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1387500/Offroad_Mechanic_Simulator/

notes.title: Offroad Mechanic Simulator Update 1.07
notes.notes:
Hi, offroad maniacs!

We're coming back with a new update, in which we resolve problems regarding parts and their mounting for specific cars and also some minor issues connected to very specific instances. We hope that all the players who experienced these rare problems will be pleased with our fixes.

We also added some minor UI cosmetic fixes, as well as amendments to the categorizing of the parts. Those small finishing touches should also positively affect the clarity of what the game is communicating. 

Please note: We are still working on the issue of parts being missing from the assembly mode selection menu, but still being present in storage. It is particularly hard to reproduce in a testing environment, and we haven't been able to provide a fix so far. Thank you for sending us saves and logs to help us find the source of the issue. The issue is resolved by reloading the save, so please use this solution until we provide a fix.
Offroad Mechanic Simulator Update 1.07 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/0e0bb02a86a3e94626c55e909d7471619e50f155.jpg

This update contains the following changes:

 Resolved the issue of being able to complete a mission of searching for Long Rider early after a rollover, and having the mission unavailable to retry and registered as finished, but without Long Rider being added to the garage
 Fixed the issue of progression not registering properly during the tutorial race
 Changed the order of removing parts while disassembling the Toyato Ground Courier
 Unified the shock absorber descriptions for Pickup 1500 in mounting mode and the shop
 Moved the Toyato Ground Courier front steering knuckle to the proper shop category (Steering)
 Amended the minor visual issue with orange icons in the UI
 Changed the default mouse Camera Rotation Sensitivity from 11 to 15
 Amended wrong choice of the word for "right" in the Portuguese translation

notes.title: Offroad Mechanic Simulator Update 1.05
notes.notes:
Hi, offroad maniacs!

We are continuing to introduce more fixes to remove outstanding issues from your experience. Today we are back with another patch, first of all addressing A key problem.

Today we resolved the keyboard issue for the two next languages you have reported to be suffering from. After the update, all players using their native Ukrainian and Finnish keyboard layouts will be able to use the A button without the need to bind it to a different diacritic symbol. 

The other issue we're addressing in this patch is related to editing the chassis of your cars. Some players have found themselves unable to put shock absorbers in their proper place, which made modifying the car harder. We have located and amended the issue, so the garage work should be hassle-free now. 

Please note: We are still working on the issue of parts being missing from the assembly mode selection menu, but still being present in storage. It is particularly hard to reproduce in a testing environment, and we haven't been able to provide a fix so far. Thank you for sending us saves and logs to help us find the source of the issue. The issue is resolved by reloading the save, so please use this solution until we provide a fix.

notes.title: Offroad Mechanic Simulator Update 1.03
notes.notes:
Hi, offroad maniacs!

We hope that you've got your fair share of fun with offroading in our game already. Nevertheless, some of you still experienced some specific issues, that we are addressing in this patch. Thank you for your bug reporting and willingness to help us in reproducing them!

In today's patch, we are introducing a requested quality-of-life change. The need for constantly closing the F1 tips was bothering some players, so we have added an option to automatically switch them off. This way you can choose to not display them when they're no longer needed.

In addition, we have removed the spare wheel holder showing as a "ghost part", mostly appearing when driving Yeep Rancher. We have also amended an issue with camera zoom during working on Pickup 1500 and a minor Mishubi Palermo screw misplacement. We have also found some instances of the winch prompt on Desert that still weren't changed to not informing about attaching the part to a tree, so we have extended our fix to include them.

Please note: we are still working on the issue of parts being missing from the assembly mode selection menu, but still being present in storage. It is particularly hard to reproduce in a testing environment, so it may take us more time - thank you for sending us saves and logs to help us to find the source of the issue. The issue is resolved by reloading the save, so please use this solution until we provide a fix.

Offroad Mechanic Simulator Update 1.03 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/2f0aaf1ac752a636910ae13b5ce9073f3e1ab709.png

This update contains the following changes:

 Added an option to automatically switch off the F1 tips instead of closing them one at the time
 Amended the issue where a previously removed spare wheel holder was still showing during races as a grey "ghost part"
 Amended the issue where a green highlight was showing in place of a previously removed spare wheel holder when washing the car
 Fixed a camera zoom issue which made installing a rear bumper on Pickup 1500 impossible without changing FOV
 Changed "use a winch on a tree" prompt instances when on Desert map missed in the previous update
 Removed an incorrectly placed screw in the Mishubi Palermo engine panel
 Adjusted a visual glitch of the To-Do List appearing after saving the completed commission
 Minor adjustment of German translation

notes.title: Offroad Mechanic Simulator Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Hi, offroad fans!

We are several weeks from the launch of Offroad Mechanic Simulator and we're very happy that you're enjoying our game. However, we also track closely all the issues you report and work as a team to remove them or provide solutions as soon as possible.

In this patch, we address a common problem you have sent to us: slow loading and slow completing of the missions in the laptop. In addition to fixes, we have added a loading indicator in that cases, so you know that game is loading and not freezing. We have also resolved some issues related to Yeep, including it being missing from the garage, as well as some visual and technical issues regarding mounting some of the parts.

Please note: we are still working on the issue of parts being missing from the assembly mode selection menu, but still being present in storage. It is particularly hard to reproduce in a testing environment, so it may take us more time - thank you for sending us saves and logs to help us to find the source of the issue. The issue is in most cases resolved by reloading the save, so please use this solution until we provide a fix.

Offroad Mechanic Simulator Update 1.02 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38515819/968f4bec933b189fb98940c44fae2dbb716c9e2a.png

This update contains the following changes:

 Implemented solutions to amend the slow loading issues during save reloading or closing the mission
 Implemented a loading indicator communicating that the game is still loading data
 Resolved the issue with Yeep disappearing from the garage after unlocking it properly
 Disabled the instance of winning the Yeep without completing the Special Race
 Allowed the E key (use object) to be rebound to LMB properly
 Changed the display that said player should use a winch on the tree when racing in the Desert to the appropriate prompt
 Added 3840x1600 resolution support
 Amended the issue when a player could start the car searching mission when the car was already found
 Amended the icon of wheel house shell changing it to showing through the car wheel in some cases
 Amended the position of front-rear absorbers on the sport suspension of Pickup 1500

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1 "GET DIRTY"
notes.notes:
We would like to express our gratitude for the positive feedback on our Offroad Mechanic Simulator Demo. We are impressed by your support😀.

The team has been working on additional fixes based on community feedback. Below is the list of game fixes and optimizations. Thank you for playing 🕹️!!! 

FIXED


 improved player hud and main tutorial windows
 improved driving mechanics (softer suspension , more adjustable to the ground, less stucking in mud, popup info about damaged engine)
 workbench minigame bugfixes (proper level of parts rust and dirt visible in inventory)
 changes and improvements in hints and player tasks
 changes and improvements in shop , added more items , sets of tuning items. 
 shop bugfixes (item searcher , interface, searching etc.)
 add option for enabling and disabling tutorial windows via game options
 fixed compass when driving car
 added the ability to tear up the winch line with too much tension (alert and information about the break appears on the player's interface). When occurs player must reattach the winch line back to the tree strap
 fix setting camera position when reseting the car
 and a lot of several bug fixes , blockers , crashes
